outcome: neuropsychological accuracy (Street Completion Test and Visual Object and Space Perception battery)
cohort: The study included 30 adolescents born preterm with normal cognitive and clinical neurological outcomes and 34 age-matched controls.
finding: In preterm adolescents, females showed greater vulnerability in central visuo-cognitive processing and their psychophysical threshold correlated with neuropsychological accuracy, which was not observed in males.
cross-section timing: Participants were assessed during adolescence (school age).
